from typing import Protocol, Any
from abc import abstractmethod

def wrapper(fn): return fn
class Contract(Protocol):
    def run(self): ...
class Base:
    @abstractmethod
    def abstract(self): ...
class Concrete:
    @property
    def value(self): return 1
    def run(self): return 1
    def second(self): return 2
    @wrapper
    def wrapped(self): return 3

def caller(x: object, y: Any, known: Base):
    x.run()
    y.run()
    known.run()
    x.value
    x.wrapped()
    x.second()
    Contract.run(x)
    Base.abstract(x)
